has_drive_scope.doc: Returns { ok: true } when the user already has an oauth_accounts row with drive.readonly scope and a refresh_token.

connect.doc: Mint the Google OAuth elevation URL (scope=drive.file, prompt=consent, access_type=offline). FE opens it in a popup window; the user grants consent; butler.google_drive_callback writes back to oauth_accounts and posts a message to the opener.

picker_token.doc: Access token + config for the FE Google Picker (drive.file flow). Returns { access_token, api_key, app_id } — app_id is the Cloud project NUMBER; all three must come from the same Cloud project as the OAuth client. Errors: PICKER_NOT_CONFIGURED (drive.json lacks api_key/project_number), NEEDS_RECONNECT.

sa_info.doc: Whole-folder import (share-to-service-account): returns { configured, email } — the SA address the user must share their Drive folder with (Viewer is enough). configured=0 when google/drive-sa.json is absent.

sa_check.doc: Validate a pasted Drive folder OR file link/id for the share-to-SA import. Share-gated: only requires the SA can SEE the item (the user shared it with the SA email) — NO owner check, so an item owned by any account can be imported. Returns { ok, folder_id, name, is_folder }. Errors: SA_NOT_CONFIGURED, SA_BAD_LINK, SA_NOT_SHARED.

folder.description: Drive folder/file URL or bare id

disconnect.doc: Forget the Drive connection: best-effort revoke the refresh_token at Google, then NULL the tokens on the Drive-scoped oauth_accounts row (kept, not deleted, so Google sign-in still works). After this get_state.ok is false. Returns { ok: true }.

list.doc: Browse one Google Drive folder for the in-app migration picker tree. Read-only, My Drive only. Returns { files: [{ id, name, is_folder, mime_type, size }], next_page_token }.

start_migration.doc: Create a migration_jobs row and enqueue the Bull worker. Returns the job_id immediately — the request does NOT wait for the migration to finish.

conflict_policy.description: skip (only policy implemented; overwrite|rename reserved for Phase 2)

selections.description: selected mode only: { folder_ids: string[], file_ids: string[] }

auth_kind.description: user (drive.file OAuth token) | sa (service-account whole-folder import; requires sa_folder, re-validated server-side)

sa_folder.description: auth_kind=sa only: Drive folder URL or id the user shared with the SA

direct_into.description: 1 = import directly INTO nid (folder-window launch); 0/absent = wrap in a GoogleDriveMigration folder under nid (settings/Home launches)

get_status.doc: Poll a Bull job by id. Returns { job_id, status, processed_files, total_files, total_folders, current_filename, errors, attempts, failed_reason, started_at, finished_at } translated from the Bull state machine to the FE popup states (queued / running / done / failed / cancelled / none).

cancel.doc: Mark the job cancelled. Removes the job from Bull's waiting queue; an active worker will exit at the next file boundary.

dismiss_post_onboarding.doc: Set profile.tools_migration_skipped.google_drive = 1 so the Desk auto-launch doesn't re-show the popup on every reload.

get_state.doc: Consolidated popup-open state so the FE can reconnect to an in-flight migration (or show a just-finished result once) instead of defaulting to the Start screen. Returns { ok (has drive scope), scope_kind ('readonly' keeps the legacy whole-Drive tree UI, 'file' switches to the Google Picker), picker (1 when api_key+project_number are configured), job (shaped getUserJob snapshot or null), seen_job_id (last dismissed result) }.

ack_result.doc: Mark a finished migration result as seen (profile.gdrive_seen_job=job_id) so reopening the popup won't show that result again.
